Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

clock — a device that shows the time. Example: The clock says three.
hour — sixty minutes. Example: I work eight hours a day.
minute — sixty seconds. Example: Wait five minutes.
o’clock — used to say the exact hour. Example: It is three o’clock.
half past — thirty minutes after the hour. Example: It is half past four.
quarter past — fifteen minutes after the hour. Example: It is quarter past six.
morning — the time before midday. Example: It is half past seven in the morning.
afternoon — the time after midday. Example: In the afternoon I have a meeting.
evening — the time at the end of the day. Example: In the evening I read.
time — the hour of the day. Example: What time is it?
